single.title: Single frame
single.text: Two players. When the frame ends, the loser pays.

double.title: Double frame
double.text: Two against two, or one against two. The losing side splits it.

century.title: Century
century.text: Any number of players. Charged by the minute under one player.

rate.label: Century rate for this game
rate.note: Starts at the owners’ price. Change it here if needed. Whole minutes are charged.
rate.noteRunning: Counts from <when>{{time}}</when>, when the game started. Whole minutes are charged.

outOfOrder.title: Mark {{name}} out of order
outOfOrder.text: Write why, for example “Cloth change”. Everyone sees it on the table.

players.title: Who is playing on {{name}}?
players.century: Century, {{price}} a minute. Charged under one player.
players.search: Search players by name or phone
players.recentNote: Same name? Check the last digits of the phone number.
players.startTime: The start time is filled in when you tap Start.

double.title: Double frame on {{name}}
double.text: {{price}} for the frame. The losing side splits it.
double.addSecond: Add a second player, or leave empty
double.search: Search a name or phone for side {{letter}}
double.noteAlone: Three players count as a double. If {{name}} plays alone and loses, he pays the full {{price}}. You can change the split when the frame ends.
double.note: Three players count as a double. If a player is alone on his side and loses, he pays the full {{price}}. You can change the split when the frame ends.

newPlayer.title: Add a new player
newPlayer.text: Their account is made now, so games and payments go under their name.
newPlayer.name: Full name
newPlayer.partial: Type the whole number, or tap “Skip phone for now”.
newPlayer.similarText: Is it one of these? Tap to use them instead.

change.title: Change the game on {{name}}
change.subtitle: Started {{ago}} as {{what}}: <name>{{who}}</name>. You can change it until <when>{{time}}</when>.
change.left_one: {{count}} minute left to change. After that, end or discard the frame first.
change.left_other: {{count}} minutes left to change. After that, end or discard the frame first.
change.tooLate: The 5 minutes to change this game are over. End or discard the frame first.
change.ended: This game is no longer running.
